InvoiceOptions.profile.doc: UBL profile of an invoice created by ``create_ubl``.

valueDocs.XRECHNUNG: The German XRechnung, in UBL syntax.

InvoiceOptions.rules.doc: Extra national rule sets, validated on top of the rules of the profile an invoice declares.

valueDocs.BR_FR: The BR-FR rules of the French e-invoicing mandate. Needs at least the BASIC profile.

propertyDocs.CreateInvoiceRequest.options: Optional rendering and processing settings. Defaults apply when omitted.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.profile: UBL profile of ``create_ubl``: picks the CustomizationID the XML declares and the rule set the invoice is validated against. ``UblProfile.PEPPOL_BIS_3`` when omitted. Ignored by the other create methods.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.rules: Extra rule sets to validate the invoice against, on top of the rules of its declared profile and without changing that profile. ``RuleSet.BR_FR`` applies the French mandate's BR-FR rules and, on Factur-X and CII, needs at least the BASIC profile. Violations reject the request with the official rule identifiers.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.language: Language of the rendered PDF template and of the default texts written into the XML when the invoice leaves them empty, such as the payment terms. English when omitted.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.brandColor: Primary brand colour in ``#RRGGBB`` form, applied to headings and accent backgrounds of the rendered PDF template. Body text is never recoloured.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.pdfUrl: Public http(s) URL of your own PDF to use as the visual layer. The generated XML is embedded into that PDF instead of the rendered template, so ``language``, ``brand_color``, ``logo_url`` and ``include_advanced_properties`` are ignored. Ignored by the XML create methods.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.logoUrl: Public URL of the seller's logo (PNG or JPEG, at most 2 MB and 4 megapixels), printed top left on the rendered PDF template and scaled to fit a 170 x 48 pt box.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.includeAdvancedProperties: When true, the rendered PDF gains an "Electronic invoice details" section listing technical properties that a classic layout does not show, such as the specification identifier, the business process, party identifiers and electronic addresses. Defaults to false.
